title: Persist immutable assignment generations and acknowledgment receipts

checkpoint.summary: V2-04 implemented and verified: immutable per-generation assignment records (issuer, sequence, instructions, pinned spec and baseline), explicit/atomic acknowledgment receipts, historical generation read API, review-driven and recovery reissue without preemption, explicit unstarted reissue with atomic HTML spec adoption, and generation-aware stale-version guards. Existing V2 task-owner exclusivity preserved.
checkpoint.nextAction: V2-04 complete. Follow-on: V2-05 immutable checkpoint/review evidence, V2-09 historical spec body retrieval, V2-11 actor permissions, and eventual V2 cutover.
verified: Per-generation immutable assignments and receipt OIDs persist through Git-CAS and cross-clone reads
Explicit AcknowledgeAssignment and atomic BeginAttempt acknowledgment verified; stale receipt/generation rejected
Recovery appends new generation while preserving previous issuance, spec OID and acknowledgment
ReissueAssignment adopts revised canonical HTML with task SpecVersion increment and new pinned generation without interrupting Working
Reviewer ChangesRequested creates new issuance only on Finished; Working owners keep current generation
Independent concurrent assignments to different task owners preserve separate generation identities
V2GetAssignment, V2AcknowledgeAssignment and V2ReissueAssignment exposed via opt-in typed MCP capability catalog
Full Client.Tests 329/329, Server.Tests 62/62, git diff --check clean
